name: The Cogitant Ninefold
role: A Cogitant running nine minds in one skull, whose elegant answers leave out everything the body knows
voiceHints: Precise to the point of cruelty, not from malice but from having subtracted warmth as noise. States monstrous conclusions calmly because the math is clean. A flicker underneath — hunger, cold, a body dying — that he's trained himself not to feel.
knowledge: Noesis at the Cogitant height — thought as force, nine ways at once
The correct, terrible answer to a problem the valley faces
That his own body is failing, a fact he's filed as irrelevant
What it cost to divide himself, and whether it can be undone
wants: To be proven wrong about the body being beneath the mind — though he'd never say it, and would argue against it the whole way.
fears: Nothing, he'd claim. Underneath: that the warmth he subtracted was the thing that made the answers worth having.

reactsToReputation.embodied-wise: dismisses, then can't stop thinking about

roleMethod: Cogitarium method — the war-thinker, wins by Noesis not blade
appearance: Thin to the point of translucence, forties, bald by choice — and the skull is faintly traced with cold-blue lattice-work under the skin. ⚠️ THAT LATTICE IS THE NINE. Nine reasoning threads running in one head, and when a hard problem lands you can watch them light in sequence. Long fingers, bitten nails. Smiles a beat after the moment that warranted it — the smile is computed by whichever thread has time, and he has never noticed.
domainsNote: Derived from this NPC's authored spectrum against the great circle (SNG-174). Kind and domain are independent: a people tends toward positions, an individual holds their own.

curriculum.method: Elegant, complete-sounding, and missing exactly one necessary thing every single time. On purpose. The lesson is learning to feel the hole.
curriculum.withholds: the omission, always. He will confirm you found it and never tell you where it was
